messages.text:
I can’t add the delivery charge to the item price or label it that way. The rack refund is BRL 119.00, based on what you paid for the item; shipping is not included in item refunds (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping charges are not refunded automatically, and your request for that charge requires a staff member to review it (refund-policy/v2/shipping; refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

The rack refund proposal is on your card. Confirm the exact proposal using the button there; a message in chat won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
